content: There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you.
author: Maya Angelou
sourceWork: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings (1969)
story:
Holding unexpressed truth, grief, or creative passion inside our chests creates an agonizing internal pressure. When we keep silent out of fear of judgment, the unspoken reality doesn't disappear—it turns inward, breeding bitterness, fatigue, and self-doubt.

Maya Angelou's insight reminds us that the temporary vulnerability of speaking your truth is nothing compared to the slow, quiet erosion of burying who you are.
reflectionPrompt: What truth or creative vision have you been keeping silent, and what would happen if you gave it a voice today?

practicalInsight: Find a safe, authentic outlet for what you've been holding back. Write it down, share it with someone you trust, or express it through creative work.
originalQuote: There is no greater agony than bearing an unshared burden.
